mapper.select: SELECT CAT_ID, UP_CAT_ID, CAT_NM, ORDR FROM CATEGORY ORDER BY ORDR, CAT_ID

SELECT CAT_ID, UP_CAT_ID, CAT_NM, ORDR FROM CATEGORY
WHERE UP_CAT_ID IS NULL
WHERE UP_CAT_ID = #{value}
ORDER BY ORDR, CAT_ID
SELECT CAT_ID, UP_CAT_ID, CAT_NM, ORDR FROM CATEGORY WHERE CAT_ID = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CATEGORY ( CAT_ID, UP_CAT_ID, CAT_NM, ORDR, REGIST_DT, REGISTER ) VALUES ( #{catId}, #{upCatId}, #{catNm}, #{ordr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{register} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CATEGORY SET CAT_NM = #{catNm}, UP_CAT_ID = #{upCatId}, ORDR = #{ordr}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDUSR = #{updusr} WHERE CAT_ID = #{catId}
